title: Gemini 4 Argon Is FREE? Google’s Paid API Catch #shorts
description:
Gemini 4 Argon is in the Gemini app for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers. But the developer Gemini API has NO free tier for Argon. Introductory developer API rates through November 30, 2026 are $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens including thinking; rates double afterward. A paid Gemini app subscription is not the same as API billing. Availability and prices may change.

Would you use the APP or the API? Comment below.
